**Finding submitted: deviation on § 12.4 (p0045).**

**What I found**
- The only non-solicitation provision in the document is § 12.4 (p0045); searches for "solicit", "no-hire", "induce", "employ or engage", "recruit" and "personnel" surfaced no other restrictive-covenant language binding us.
- It fails the fallback on every material term and lands in walk-away territory: one-way against Customer, covers **any** Vendor employee, runs **24 months** post-term, contains a **no-hire** ("hire, or employ"), and expressly kills any general-advertising carve-out with "regardless of how the employee applies".
- It also contradicts § 12.3 (p0044), where Vendor acknowledges we have made "no … no-hire commitment."
- The second § 12.4 (p0046) is a non-compete — left to its own rule, not double-flagged here.

**Redline (validated ok:true)**
A single surgical replace narrowing the clause to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, twelve months from the end of their involvement, with general advertisements, unsolicited approaches and hiring all carved out. (Deletion of the whole clause — our preferred position — was rejected by the minimality gate, so the fallback narrowing carries the change; the comment records that our preference remains no non-solicit on us.)
